  director = 'Various (showrunner: Cheo Hodari Coker)',
  `cast` = 'Mike Colter as Luke Cage, Alfre Woodard as Mariah Dillard, Mustafa Shakir as John McIver / Bushmaster, Theo Rossi as Shades, Simone Missick as Misty Knight, Gabrielle Dennis as Tilda Johnson, Finn Jones as Danny Rand',
  tagline = 'The king of Harlem faces a new challenger. Power corrupts — even the bulletproof.',
  description = 'Luke Cage Season 2 finds the bulletproof hero as a celebrity in Harlem, but a new threat emerges in Bushmaster, a Jamaican crime lord with powers rivaling Luke''s own, while Mariah Dillard''s descent into full villainy threatens everything Luke has built.',
  imageUrl = 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310419663027009739/SGHqXeh8PZJcCDnFiAMuFi/luke-cage-s2-featured-PaZnfM8GCRuzr8C5kCMhKx.webp',
  episodeCount = 13, seasonCount = 2, platform = 'Netflix',
  rtCriticsScore = 82, rtAudienceScore = 58, verdict = 'hit',
  cardMarketContent = '## Luke Cage S2 Cards: Bushmaster and the Power Dynamic

Season 2 introduced Bushmaster, whose Jamaican mysticism and physical prowess made for compelling card imagery. The Danny Rand crossover episodes also created dual-hero cards that are popular with collectors wanting the Heroes for Hire dynamic.',
  keyCards = '- **2019 Upper Deck Marvel Annual Luke Cage S2** — Updated card reflecting Season 2, $3-10
- **2018 Upper Deck Defenders Luke Cage/Iron Fist Dual** — Heroes for Hire pairing, $8-20
- **2019 Marvel Premier Misty Knight** — Fan-favorite character card, $5-15',
  content = '## Bushmaster: A Worthy Opponent

Mustafa Shakir''s Bushmaster was everything Season 1''s Diamondback wasn''t — a villain with legitimate grievances, cultural depth, and physical presence that matched Luke blow for blow. His Jamaican heritage and nightshade-powered abilities brought a supernatural element that elevated the street-level action.

## Mariah''s Final Form

Alfre Woodard''s Mariah Dillard completed her transformation from reluctant politician to full crime lord. Her descent was Shakespearean in scope — a woman who convinced herself every terrible act was justified. Woodard''s performance in the final episodes was Emmy-worthy.

## Heroes for Hire

The Danny Rand crossover episodes gave fans the Heroes for Hire team-up they''d been waiting for. Finn Jones and Mike Colter had genuine chemistry, and the lighter tone of their partnership provided welcome relief from the season''s darker themes.

## Fun Facts

- Mustafa Shakir learned Jamaican patois for the role and worked with dialect coaches
- The season finale''s twist ending was designed to set up a Season 3 that never came
- Alfre Woodard was simultaneously appearing in the MCU films as a different character
- The reggae and dancehall soundtrack was curated by the showrunner himself',
  metaDescription = 'Luke Cage Season 2 (2018) guide — Bushmaster rivalry, Mariah''s descent, Heroes for Hire, trading card values, and the tragic ending of Harlem''s paradise.',
  keywords = 'luke cage season 2, bushmaster, mariah dillard, heroes for hire, netflix marvel, mike colter, marvel cards',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel Luke Cage Heroes for Hire cards',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Is Luke Cage Season 2 better than Season 1?","answer":"Many fans consider Season 2 more consistent than Season 1, particularly praising Bushmaster as a more compelling villain throughout. The season maintains its quality more evenly across all 13 episodes."},{"question":"Does Iron Fist appear in Luke Cage Season 2?","answer":"Yes, Danny Rand appears in multiple episodes, giving fans the Heroes for Hire team-up dynamic from the comics."}]',
  status = 'published'
WHERE slug = 'luke-cage-season-2-2018'
